property_summary: For any admissible input, calling c.forward(helper, "") after funding c must leave c's balance intact because a plain call executes the callee in its own context (its selfdestruct drains only the helper); with delegatecall the helper's selfdestruct runs in C's context and drains c, so address(c).balance becomes 0 for some fuzzed amount.
change_summary: Replace call with delegatecall so the callee executes in the contract's storage/context, changing observable effects of forward.
